SYNTHETIC TEST JUDGMENT - invented for LexFlow's automated tests. It is not a real judgment, has no legal authority and must never be cited.

Asha Rao v. Bharat Traders (SYNTHETIC)
SYNTHETIC High Court (test fixture)
Decided: 2019-03-14

The landlord sued for arrears of rent of a shop let on a monthly tenancy. The tenant stopped paying rent from April and the arrears accumulated over eleven months. The court held that a tenant who withholds rent because the landlord failed to carry out repairs must first give written notice of the defect and may deduct only the reasonable cost of repairs actually carried out. The suit was decreed for the arrears with interest.
